senses.gloss: ह्रेप् (ऋ) ह्रेपृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रेपते) To go.

ह्रेपण n. (-ण) Putting to shame, excelling, surpassing.
 E. ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

ह्रेपयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Putting to shame, outvieing, surpassing. E.
ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., शतृ aff.

ह्रेष् (ऋ) ह्रेषृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रेषते)
 1. To sound inarticulately, to neigh, (as
horse.)
 2. To go, to move.
 3. To creep.

ह्रेषा f. (-षा) Neighing as a horse.
 E. ह्रेष् to neigh, affs. अ and टाप् see हेषा; also read ह्लेषा
